text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I heard all about it. You managed to 
photobomb my interview picture, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You caught me? Gentildonna-san naturally 
draws a lot of attention, you see~

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I just can't resist photobombing. Peace.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Is that so? In other words—you 
used me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. To put it bluntly, it's 
opportunistic marketing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Also, I was thinking it'd be nice if you 
could hold a Machan doll next time, or 
something like that.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Nerves of steel and heaps of courage as 
always. You really are quite adorable, my 
dear.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Right? After all, Chan-me is destined to 
become the eternal, world-class super 
mascot.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Eternity... the world! Aiming high, aren't 
we! *sigh* Truly a delightful girl.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That ambition pleases me. Do be sure to 
entertain me thoroughly.
